contextual_resolubility_validation.validation_summary: Requirement contains vagueness regarding the modality of the reset action. Context provides no business rules or constraints to resolve the preference level.

unsupported_interpretations: The ECU MUST perform a reset when leaving Factory mode.
The ECU SHOULD perform a reset when leaving Factory mode (but may skip it).
The ECU MAY perform a reset when leaving Factory mode (optional behavior).
evidence_from_requirement: The adverb 'preferably' introduces a fuzzy preference rather than a determinate requirement.
missing_information: Business rule defining the mandatory nature of the reset.
Constraint specifying the consequence of skipping the reset.
ambiguity_resolubility.justification: Context lacks business rules or constraints to define the modality of the action.

overall_resolubility.explanation: Vagueness regarding action modality cannot be resolved by the provided context. Execution must be routed away from Agent 3.
